title: Чтобы не допустить результат
description: Чтобы не допустить результат: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
notes: In order not to miss the train — чтобы не опоздать на поезд.
Not относится к цели действия; его удаление меняет намерение.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: We left early in order ___ the introduction.
exercises.explanation: In order not to miss — стандартная отрицательная цель.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: for / to.

public_payload.sentence: She checked the date in order not ___ confuse the meetings.

exercises.editorial_answer: She checked the date in order not to confuse the meetings.
exercises.explanation: После not в этой конструкции нужен to-infinitive.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Мы проверили адрес, чтобы не заблудиться.»
exercises.editorial_answer: We checked the address in order not to get lost.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: I wrote it down in order not forget.

accepted: I wrote it down in order not to forget.

exercises.reference_answer: I wrote it down in order not to forget.
exercises.incorrect_answer: I wrote it down in order not forget.
exercises.editorial_answer: I wrote it down in order not to forget.

public_payload.passage: The organiser added a prominent date to the notice in order not to confuse readers with an earlier version. The first draft had looked almost identical to the old announcement. A volunteer suggested removing the date to make the design cleaner. The organiser kept it, explaining that the detail served a specific preventive purpose. A cleaner appearance would not necessarily help if readers then assumed that an obsolete schedule was current.

options.label: To prove that every reader had already understood.
To prevent confusion with an earlier version.

exercises.editorial_answer: To prevent confusion with an earlier version.
exercises.explanation: Цель — предотвращение путаницы, не подтверждение понимания всеми.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: avoid — избегать; prevent — предотвращать; purpose — цель; misunderstanding — недоразумение
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: avoid — избегать; prevent — предотвращать; purpose — цель; misunderstanding — недоразумение.

public_payload.passage: The organiser added a prominent date to the notice in order not to confuse readers with an earlier version. The first draft had looked almost identical to the old announcement. A volunteer suggested removing the date to make the design cleaner. The organiser kept it, explaining that the detail served a specific preventive purpose. A cleaner appearance would not necessarily help if readers then assumed that an obsolete schedule was current.

exercises.explanation: Внешняя чистота не заменила функциональную ясность.
